1975.label: 1975 car
1975.benchmark: Niki Lauda's 1975 pole, 6:58.6 on the 22.8 km Grand Prix layout (196.4 km/h)

2001.label: 2001 car
2001.benchmark: Juan Pablo Montoya's 2001 pole, 1:38.117 on the 6.825 km layout (250.4 km/h)

2026.label: 2026 car
2026.benchmark: the middle of every 2026 car calibrated to a real circuit

nordschleife.name: Nürburgring Nordschleife
nordschleife.note: Today's 20.8 km loop. The Grand Prix layout also used the old pit straight, now under the modern circuit, for 22.8 km.
nordschleife.record: Fastest lap ever: Timo Bernhard, Porsche 919 Evo, 5:19.546 (2018).

hockenheim.name: Hockenheimring, old layout
hockenheim.note: The long forest straights with three chicanes, replaced in 2002 by today's shorter track. The forest section is now woodland again.

spa.name: Spa-Francorchamps, old layout
spa.note: Public roads closed for racing: down through Burnenville and Malmedy, flat out along the Masta straight to the Stavelot hairpin, and back up through Blanchimont. Routed along today's roads, which don't follow the old line exactly (14.6 km against the real 14.1).
spa.record: Fastest lap ever: Henri Pescarolo, Matra MS670, 3:13.4 in the 1973 Spa 1000 km (about 262 km/h).
